$comment: Daily blog topic pipeline. The daily-note lane draws from here in order instead of chasing news, so the feed is planned rather than reactive and the clusters get covered evenly. workingTitle and targetQuery are a brief, not a script: the agent researches and writes the real thing, and may sharpen the angle. Anything it cannot source properly it marks 'skipped' with a reason rather than padding. Refill when the queue drops below about 20.
